featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing dining experience at Wok Hei, and it truly exceeded expectations. The ambiance is warm, vibrant, and perfect for enjoying authentic Chinese cuisine. From the very beginning, everything felt well-organized and welcoming.
We started with the Chef’s Crab Soup, which was rich, flavorful, and incredibly comforting. The balance of spices and the generous crab content made it stand out, setting a great tone for the meal. It was easily one of the highlights of our visit.
For the main course, we ordered the Chicken Chinese Sizzlers, served piping hot and full of bold flavors. The chicken was tender, the vegetables were fresh, and the sauce complemented the dish perfectly. The sizzling presentation added to the excitement, and the portion size was quite satisfying.
A special mention goes to Shraddha from the staff, who made our experience even better. She was courteous, attentive, and very helpful with recommendations. Her service was prompt and professional, ensuring we were comfortable throughout the meal.
Overall, Wok Hei delivers a fantastic combination of delicious food, great ambiance, and excellent service. It’s a perfect spot for anyone craving quality Chinese food, and I would highly recommend it. Looking forward to visiting again and exploring more from their menu. 🍽️🔥

featured_reviews.review_text:
Located near Pestom Sagar Road No. 4 in Chembur, Flavours Of China is a great destination for anyone who loves authentic and flavour-packed Chinese cuisine. The restaurant is easy to locate and sits in a lively area, making it convenient for both quick meals and relaxed dining with friends or family. featured_reviews.name: Kshitij Rane
featured_reviews.review_text:
🍝 THE GOLDEN WOK 🍝

Craving for Authentic Chinese food? Here's a perfect place for you to hangout and have Some good quality food experience.

The Golden wok located in chembur, Trombay road,Near the Diamond Garden is a cosy and beautiful Food Outlet easily reachable via Train bus or car/bike.

The Ambience of this place is amazing!
The inner ambience is well decorated with nice paintings contrasting the interior design and complimenting the Chinese food culture. The outer ambience is pretty decent and well lit. This place gives a typical Authentic Chinese Vibe and the dim lighting and lanterns make it a cool atmosphere to enjoy the delicious food items.

The service Here is soo helpful and perfect! The staff members are punctual and polite and help us choose the right dish for us to enjoy and feed our hunger.

We ordered -

🔹 The Golden Wok Special Mocktail 🍹 - We ordered the Watermelon flavor which had the fresh watermelon juice along with other fruits like lemon orange and mint leaves. It was a fresh and tasty drink to have and get refreshed instantly!

🔹 The Fruit Punch 🍒 - The Juice of mixture of various fruits like Orange Pomogranate Lemon melon etc. Must try drink along with the starters.

🔹Veg Steamed Dumpling Momos 🥟- They were served Hot in the typical Steamed Wooden basket. Tasted good and were well cooked!

🔹 Kung Pao Chicken Dry 🍡 - Was a good starter choice and was delicious! The garnishing was perfect and served fresh & Hot 🔥 It had a similar taste like the regular chicken 65 but the different spices in it took this cuisine to the next level.

🔹Chicken Chilli Oyster Dry 🥠 - This dish had the perfect blending of the chicken and the taste of oyster in it. Must try starter if you ever visit the golden wok! Found this item very unique and loved it.

🔹The Chicken Prawns Fish Manchow Soup 🍜 - This soup was mouthwatering and it had a very different taste with a pinch of sea food variation and chicken perfectly cooked and served hot with fried dry noodles along with it.

🔹Chicken Burnt garlic Sauce Noodles 🍝 - The taste of burnt garlic sauce and the hakka noodles tossed it it was a great combination and wholesome dish for one person to have. Was very filling and delicious.

🔹Pepper chilli Chicken Gravy 🍛 - This was a new item i had for the first time and loved it. The taste of black pepper spice and chilli sauce mixed with boiled chicken was amazing! This is an ideal gravy dish to have along with A Rice plate.

🔹Chicken Fried Rice 🍚 - The everyday Chicken Fried rice had a good taste and the perfect Chinese blend in it. Had this with the pepper chilli gravy and loved the combination ♥️.

🔹The Caramel Custard 🍮 - This pudding was very sweet and delicious. Well made and served along with the Carmel syrup. A good Dessert option.

🔹The chocolate Mousse 🍨 - The Perfect dessert anyone can have after a good lunch/dinner! The chocolate mousse had a topping of  chocolate cream and at the bottom it had a mixture of chocolate icecream and Mixed cream. Best dessert choice!

My experience was Splendid! At such an amazing place...one will definitely enjoy good quality food with good Ambience and services provided. Must visit this place and Enjoy the Chinese cuisines and get away with Chinese food cravings😋.

Loved this place and will definitely suggest everyone out there...especially the foodies to visit this place and Come back with good memories and Tasty food experience!

Ambience - 10/10

Food quality - 10/10
Pricing - 9/10

Thank you :)

From the moment we stepped through the rustic wooden door, the warm ambiance and aromatic blend of garlic, herbs, and fresh bread set the stage for what would become a memorable evening.

## The Atmosphere
The interior strikes a perfect balance between cozy and elegant, with exposed brick walls adorned with vintage Italian photographs and soft lighting from wrought-iron fixtures. The gentle hum of conversation creates an intimate setting that's ideal for both romantic dinners and casual gatherings with friends.

## The Food
Our server, Maria, was knowledgeable and genuinely enthusiastic about the menu. We started with the burrata appetizer – a creamy, indulgent portion served with perfectly ripe tomatoes and a drizzle of aged balsamic that had us savoring every bite.

For mains, the handmade pappardelle with wild boar ragu was exceptional. The pasta had that perfect al dente texture you can only get from fresh noodles, and the rich, slowly-simmered sauce spoke of hours of careful preparation. My dining companion's osso buco was equally impressive – the meat fell off the bone, and the risotto beneath was creamy perfection.

## Service
The service struck that sweet spot of being attentive without being intrusive. Our water glasses never went empty, and Maria checked in at just the right moments. When we mentioned celebrating an anniversary, they surprised us with a complimentary tiramisu that was the perfect end to our meal.

## Value
While not bargain dining, the prices are fair for the quality and portion sizes. Entrees range from $18-28, and given the fresh ingredients and evident care in preparation, it feels like good value.

## Minor Notes
The only small critique would be that the acoustics can make it slightly noisy when full, and reservations are definitely recommended as this place fills up quickly – a testament to its quality.

**Would I return?** Absolutely. Rare Kitchen has earned a spot on our regular rotation, and I'm already planning to bring friends who appreciate authentic Italian cuisine served with genuine hospitality.

Craving for some delicious Chinese or Asian cuisines- give this place a try. A perfect place for your cravings. Tried few of the food items along with drinks. It was a good experience.

Spicy garlic chicken: chicken pieces tossed in the wok and mixed well with the spices. However taste failed to bring any charm, but for the garlic feel it can be given a try.

Schezwan chicken bao: delicious and that's all. Two pieces of baos in one serving. The schezwan feel was great. A must try.

Crunchy vegetable dumpling: Comes in with sweet, cheesy, and tangy sauce. Dumplings were delicious. Soft and luscious.

Assorted vegetable dumplings: This one with was schezwan sauce. Better than the previous dumpling choice.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Wok Express is one of the early entrants in the Pan-Asian QSR scene. Their journey started in May 2015 with 5 outlets in the 1st year and after 3 years of being in business, they boast of 20+ outlets in Mumbai itself.

I was invited by the management of Wok Express for try out their menu and review them, the choice was outlet was left to me and chose the Chembur outlet.

Wok Express at Chembut is located in Cubic Mall of C G Road. The shopping mall is quite a known / famous landmark in that locality.

The ambience is pretty good, nothing fancy though. They have laid out multiple wooden tables with wooden stools. The lighting is pretty ambient and focuses on food on the table.

CHILI MUSHROOM BAO [INR 125]
A Bao is steamed rolled bread which is very popular is Chinese cuisine. You can eat it after stuffing it with any filling one wants.
The Bao which I ordered had a thick stuffing of slices mushrooms cooked in a tangy tomato base with some chili sauce. The filling was nice & juicy but the flavor of the chili was lacking. It need not have been spicy but the presence should have been felt.

TANUKI DUMPLING [INR 160]
A wonderful steamed dumpling which was basically a wonton sheet wrapped with finely chopped spring onion and some assorted vegetables. It was served topped with some chili oil & soy chili sauce. They flavor of this dish was wonderful and was served on a bed of tempura crumbs.
RECOMMENDED

CRISPY WATERCHESTNUT [INR 225]
This dish is combination of waterchestnut & baby corn fried in a corn batter.The fried balls are then tossed in a Kung Pao sauce and served topped with fried cashew nuts. The flavor & crunch of the dish was amazing.
RECOMMENDED

VEG GREEN  THAI CURRY WITH RICE [INR 160]
I was disappointed with this preparation.
The preparation of Thai Curry does involve the use of Kaffir Lime & Galangal which is used for imparting a certain flavor to the curry, which I found missing big time from the curry served at Wok Express. The curry has a certain degree of sweetness and thickness which is derived from the coconut milk used, this also was missing.

PERSONAL BOX [INR 165]
I chose a Personal Box in a small size with flat wheat noodles, chili pepper sauce, fried onion, cilantro, bean sprouts, button mushrooms, tofu and spring onion.
Red Chili Pepper sauce was supposed to be slightly spicy but the sauce used here was not spicy. The overall mixture was nice and tossed well but again I guess the undoing was the rancid crushed peanuts. It gave out a slightly odd aroma to the preparation hence I returned the preparation and was taken back by the Manager without a question.

The service level was pretty good. I placed the order for all dishes at a time to enable them to serve better. They could do better is spacing the order so that the customer can consume the first serving and then move to the next dish.

Wok Express delighted me in some dishes and equally disappointed me in some. The good ones were really good and they need to look into the areas of improvement especially the use of ingredients like Peanuts which end up spoiling the entire dish; it was a mixed bag experience for me

Food Quality – 3/5
Food Qunatity – 3.5/5
Ambiance – 3.5/5
Service – 3.5/5
Price – NA [I did not pay for the meal, since it was a review by invitation but the prices are pocket friendly]

featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are looking for a place where quality meets quantity in the most elegant way possible, Global Fusion is the ultimate destination. I recently visited for a weekend dinner, and honestly, I am still thinking about the experience. It isn’t just a meal; it’s an absolute marathon of flavors.
The Ambience and Vibe
From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere sets the tone. The decor is sophisticated, featuring beautiful water bodies, ambient lighting, and a spacious layout that makes it feel premium despite being a popular, busy spot. It’s perfect for everything from a romantic date night to a loud, celebratory family dinner.
The Food: A Deep Dive
The star of the show here is undoubtedly the buffet, which leans heavily toward Asian and Seafood specialties. Unlike many buffets where food sits out getting cold, Global Fusion serves a significant portion of their appetizers right to your table, piping hot.
The Sushi & Sashimi: The sushi conveyor belt (or the platter service) is a dream. The fish was incredibly fresh, and the variety of vegetarian and non-vegetarian rolls was impressive.
Starters: This is where they truly shine. The Prawns Tempura were crispy and light, and the Chicken Teriyaki had the perfect glaze. If you enjoy dim sum, their baskets are translucent, delicate, and packed with flavor.
Main Course: By the time you get to the mains, you might be struggling, but don’t skip the Burmese Khow Suey or their signature fish in black bean sauce. The flavors are authentic and not "dumbed down."
Desserts: Save room! From the Baskin Robbins ice cream station to the chocolate fountain and the tiny, elegant pastries, the dessert spread is a grand finale in every sense.
Service & Hospitality
The staff deserves a special shout-out. Despite the restaurant being at full capacity, the service was seamless. Our servers were attentive, clearing plates quickly and ensuring the "unlimited" starters kept flowing without us having to ask twice.
The Verdict
Is it pricey? Yes, it’s a bit of an investment. But considering the premium seafood, the sheer variety of cuisines (Japanese, Chinese, Indian, and more), and the high-end service, it is worth every penny.
